Convex order makes the difference of the curves nonnegative, so at its zero the left derivative is nonpositive and right derivative nonnegative. Their signs yield the displayed opposite inequalities. Null target boundary then squeezes both source cap masses to the same value.

Vanishing total conditional Jensen defect gives rowwise equality almost everywhere. For a strictly below row, the nonnegative positive part must vanish. For an above row, subtracting the affine mean reduces to the negative part. At threshold the row is on one closed side with mean on the plane and therefore lies on the plane.
